title: Alcance de 都 según el tipo de asociado y 只

claimAssessments.claim: Liu (2021) argues that scope patterns around 都 depend on the type of associate. A quantificational ‘only’ phrase cannot intervene between 都 and 每-NP in the cited example, whereas 只有 (zhǐyǒu) is reported as acceptable between a demonstrative plural such as 這些書 and 都. The article contrasts quantificational associates with referential plural definites; it does not validate the original invented examples or a blanket ordering rule for 都 and 只.
